question: Estimate the number of Zoom (or equivalent video conferencing) meetings hosted per day from India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Includes Zoom + Google Meet + MS Teams + Webex + Jio Meet? Yes.
Only meetings hosted from India (host's geography)? Yes.
Both work + edtech + personal calls? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Segment by use case: corporate meetings + edtech classes + personal calls.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian knowledge workers (corporate + IT services + freelance): ~50M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, host video calls weekly: ~60% = 30M, average ~5 meetings/week = ~6M corporate hosted meetings/day (across all platforms).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Personal video calls (family, friends, casual): ~25M Indians make a video call per day, of which ~30% via apps like Zoom/Meet (rest via WhatsApp/FT) = 7.5M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total daily meetings: ~6M + 0.6M + 7.5M = ~14M meetings hosted from India per day.

calculationFlow: Indian knowledge workers (corporate + IT services + freelance): ~50M.
Of these, host video calls weekly: ~60% = 30M, average ~5 meetings/week = ~6M corporate hosted meetings/day (across all platforms).
Edtech live class hosts: ~150K teachers/instructors with ~3-4 sessions/day = ~500K-600K meetings/day.
Personal video calls (family, friends, casual): ~25M Indians make a video call per day, of which ~30% via apps like Zoom/Meet (rest via WhatsApp/FT) = 7.5M.
Total daily meetings: ~6M + 0.6M + 7.5M = ~14M meetings hosted from India per day.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Total daily meetings: ~6M + 0.6M + 7.5M = ~14M meetings hosted from India per day.
